findings.rationale: Correct: R11 has no exception for malformed invocations. Folded P2 step 2: main uses Cli::try_parse(); a parse failure whose argv[1] is 'hook' prints a Traditional Chinese usage line and exits 1; binary integration tests for missing and unknown names.

Correct: Command inherits stdio by default, so a non-git settings file would leak git's English 'fatal:' to the user on the default path. Folded P1 step 3: stdin/stderr null, ls-files reads exit status only, rev-parse via output(); spawn errors and non-zero map to None; test asserts no 'fatal:' on install --dry-run stderr.

Correct: run_uninstall returns early on !exists(), which is true for a dangling link. Folded P1 step 2: check_settings_path runs before the exists() check in run_uninstall; test covers uninstall on a dangling link.

Correct: dirs::data_local_dir ignores XDG_DATA_HOME on macOS. Folded P2 step 1: CODEFORGE_DATA_LOCAL_DIR override in default_data_local_dir; unit tests call materialize_in(base, name) with a tempdir instead of setting env (set_var races under cargo test); §5 e2e uses the new override.

Correct: inherited stdin cannot be fed in a unit test. Folded: exec_script takes a Stdio for stdin; production passes Stdio::inherit and never reads stdin; tests pass Stdio::from(File) with a JSON temp file and assert stdin/argv byte-equal plus exit 7 and 2 pass through.

Correct and important: in a shared file a 0.0.6 machine would hit clap's unknown-subcommand exit 2 (PreCompact blocks). Folded §2.6, §6, P4 step 5 and CHANGELOG: every machine self-updates to 0.0.7 before the rewritten settings.json enters the shared source; no dual-writing of old node paths.
